title: Deleting an Issue from the Entra ID Change Detection Issue Safelist

blocks.text: You can delete an Entra ID change detection issue that is marked safe from the Entra ID Change Detection Issue Safelist.
To delete an Entra ID change detection issue from the safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > Entra ID Change Detection Issue Safelist.
Select a tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon to remove the object from the safelist.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
When you remove an issue from the safelist, it gets added to the Entra ID Change Detection dashboard.
